subject: Opportunity capacity sweep & runbook for AuroraCorp POC
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Emma Liang <emma@auroracorp.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Opportunity capacity sweep & runbook for AuroraCorp POC

Team — looping in the ops and CS leads to validate capacity for AuroraCorp's upcoming POC. Key asks below; please respond with a quick availability snapshot and any blockers by EOD today so we can confirm during the Tuesday exec sync.

Summary of ask
- Customer: AuroraCorp (Proof-of-concept starting target May 15)
- Requested dedicated pool: equivalent to 8x A100-80GB (sustained inference), with headroom for 2x burst nodes for heavy evals
- Expected ramp: 0.5–1M tokens/day first week, scaling to ~5M tokens/day by week 4
- SLA target: 99.9% p99 latency SLA for interactive endpoints

Action items
1) Ben: inventory snapshot + any contention windows in May–June
2) Rishi: compatibility check for Aurora's quantized model and fallback plan (if we need 8x -> can we compress to 6x with quantization?)
3) Laura: customer communication template and ask procurement contact for formal capacity request

Attachments: auroracorp-poc-sow.pdf, runbook-capacity-checklist.xlsx (runbook link below).

Drive runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Aurora-POC-Runbook

Thanks — I want minimal friction here; if we can provision a provisional hold while we finalize commercial terms that would help.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Liang <emma@auroracorp.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opportunity capacity sweep & runbook for AuroraCorp POC

Tessa / team — quick ops snapshot:
- Current free pool (US-west): capacity equivalent to ~10x A100-80GB nodes across the dedicated fleet, but ~60% of that is already earmarked for Q2 ramp customers between 04/25–05/20.
- Contention window: May 12–18 has scheduled maintenance on a subset of the west fleet (two racks), that would reduce immediate headroom by ~2 nodes if maintenance proceeds as planned. Ops can shift workloads but it incurs a ~24–48h lead time for node reallocation.

Recommendations:
- If the customer can slide start to May 18 we can give a cleaner guarantee; otherwise we can place a provisional soft-hold for the requested 8-node equivalent with Ops during the procurement review.
- I need a firm deal_id and estimated commitment term to place a soft reservation (we typically require a 3‑month rolling commitment for provisional holds).

Attachment: runbook-capacity-checklist.xlsx referenced for the node map.

Ben Carter
Capacity Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opportunity capacity sweep & runbook for AuroraCorp POC

Ben / Tessa — technical sizing notes from model team: 
- Model compatibility: AuroraCorp plans to run a 70B transformer fine-tuned for retrieval-augmented generation. Baseline memory/cpu requires ~8x A100-80GB for low-latency 1–2-shot interactive use at target seq lengths.
- Quantization path: using our int8 quantized variant we can reduce VRAM footprint ~25% and run on 6x A100-80GB equivalents at modest latency cost (p95 +10–20ms). We should validate accuracy drift on the customer's eval set — recommend a short eval run to verify quality delta.
- KV cache behavior: heavy long-context usage will increase memory; if Aurora enables extended-history chat we will need to provision extra KV cache nodes.

Operational asks for ops hold:
1) Create a provisional hold ticket in the capacity queue (Ben) referencing deal_id AC-2027-0419 and mark as dependent on procurement signoff.
2) Schedule a 30m tech sync with Aurora infra and our model infra (I'll join) to validate quantized evals (propose Thu 04/21 10:00 PDT).

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Emma Liang <emma@auroracorp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 13:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opportunity capacity sweep & runbook for AuroraCorp POC

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple clarifications from procurement side: 
- We can start on May 15 only if the maintenance window you mentioned is cleared; otherwise May 20 is acceptable.
- We are prepared to sign a 3‑month initial commitment for the POC (can extend), will route paperwork through procure@aurora.ai.

Next steps from our side:
1) I'll confirm with our infra lead whether the evals can run with the int8 quantized variant and share a small eval corpus by EOD Wednesday.
2) Please send a DocuSign or countersign link for the provisional reservation (if you require a signature to activate the hold).

—Emma Liang
Head of Platform | AuroraCorp
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liang <emma@auroracorp.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 15:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opportunity capacity sweep & runbook for AuroraCorp POC

Emma — great, glad to hear the 3-month commitment is available. Ben — can you open the provisional hold ticket and mark it as contingent on the signed MOU? Please include the maintenance window note and set expiry 05/05 by default.

Rishi — I'll schedule the technical sync for Thu 04/21 10:00 PDT and add the Aurora eval corpus to the runbook when they send it. Laura — can you prepare the procurement-facing summary (one-pager) and attach DocuSign link for the provisional hold?

I'll parking-lot the rest in the Drive runbook and update HubSpot (ID 9802345). Thanks everyone for the fast responses — let's keep the loop tight this week.

Best,
